contractVersion.description: The contract version this manifest is written against, exactly 0.1.0 (docs/specification/versioning.md#one-contract-pin).

provider.description: Who provides the capabilities: identity, revision and the contract versions it speaks (docs/specification/overview.md#common-identity-and-references).

id.description: The provider's stable URI, which a provider entry's providerId names (docs/specification/provider.md#what-the-schema-adds-to-the-table).

revision.description: This manifest's revision, an integer from 1 that grows with each published change (docs/specification/versioning.md#revision-shape).

contentHash.description: The sha256 of this manifest revision's content (docs/specification/overview.md#common-identity-and-references).

createdAt.description: When this revision was written, an RFC 3339 UTC instant (docs/specification/overview.md#common-identity-and-references).

createdBy.description: A URI naming who or what wrote this revision (docs/specification/overview.md#common-identity-and-references).

name.description: The provider's name as a person reads it, 1 to 120 characters.

description.description: What the provider does, in up to 1000 characters.

identity.description: How the host verifies who the provider is: a subject URI and a method (docs/specification/registry.md#identity-and-trust).

subject.description: The URI the identity proof is about (docs/specification/registry.md#identity-and-trust).

method.description: How the identity is proven: tls, oauth2, signed-manifest or local-install (docs/specification/registry.md#identity-and-trust).

proofUri.description: Where the proof can be read, when the method has one (docs/specification/registry.md#identity-and-trust).

supportedContractVersions.description: Every contract version the provider implements, as semantic versions (docs/specification/versioning.md#one-contract-pin).

extensions.description: Vendor data, keyed by an absolute URI; the service extension names the descriptor this manifest belongs to (docs/specification/overview.md#extension-rule).

https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-cont.description: The service extension: this manifest is a Fabric service's (docs/specification/service.md).

descriptor.description: The service key <id>.<instance> of the descriptor this manifest belongs to (docs/specification/service.md).

capabilities.description: What the provider offers, one entry per capability, each with its compatibility profile (docs/specification/profiles.md#common-declaration).

name.description: The capability's name; for an MCP capability with the interop extension, its tool's name (docs/specification/interop.md).

description.description: What the capability does, in up to 1000 characters.

inputSchema.description: The URI of the JSON Schema its input follows (docs/specification/profiles.md#common-declaration).

outputSchema.description: The URI of the JSON Schema its output follows (docs/specification/profiles.md#common-declaration).

effect.description: The strongest external effect the capability can have (docs/specification/governance-and-roles.md#external-effects).

idempotency.description: Whether a call takes an idempotency key: required, supported or none (docs/specification/profiles.md#common-declaration).

dataClasses.description: The data classes the capability reads or writes (docs/specification/governance-and-roles.md#data-classification).

profile.description: How the host reaches the capability: an mcp, a2a or local-runner profile, chosen by kind (docs/specification/profiles.md).

extensions.description: Vendor data, keyed by an absolute URI; the interop extension describes the MCP tool (docs/specification/overview.md#extension-rule).

https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-cont.description: The interop extension: how the capability is served as an MCP tool (docs/specification/interop.md).

extensions.description: Vendor data for the whole manifest, keyed by an absolute URI (docs/specification/overview.md#extension-rule).

costPresets.description: DEC-0037: fixed options a launcher offers for a task whose cost varies (L2).

id.description: The preset's id, a slug of up to 40 characters (docs/specification/package.md#cost-presets).

capability.description: The capability the preset is for, by name (docs/specification/package.md#cost-presets).

label.description: The option's label as a launcher shows it.

maxUsd.description: The most one task under this preset may spend, in USD (docs/specification/package.md#cost-presets).

paidTools.description: How many paid tool calls the preset allows.

depth.description: How deep the task goes, in the provider's own words.

default.description: Whether the launcher offers this preset first.

inputFixture.description: The URI of the bounded input the probe sends (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

outputSchema.description: The URI of the schema the probe's result follows (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

timeoutMs.description: How long the probe may take, 1 to 300000 milliseconds (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

sideEffectCeiling.description: The most the probe may do: none, or a draft (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

assertions.description: What the result must show, one assertion per item (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

profile.description: A capability profile, checked on the branch its kind selects, so a mistake reports that branch's errors only (docs/specification/profiles.md).

mcpProfile.description: The mcp profile; its version member is protocolRevision (docs/specification/profiles.md#mcp-capability-profile).

protocolRevision.description: The mcp profile's version member; only this profile carries protocolRevision (docs/specification/profiles.md#mcp-capability-profile).

connection.description: How the host connects: streamable-http with a url, or stdio with an executable and its arguments (docs/specification/profiles.md#mcp-capability-profile).

mode.description: How the host reaches the server; the branch it selects is checked alone, so one mistake reports that branch's errors.

executableRef.description: The URI of the executable the host starts (docs/specification/profiles.md#mcp-capability-profile).

args.description: The executable's arguments, an array of strings, never a shell string and never a credential (docs/specification/profiles.md#no-secret-in-a-command-line).

scope.description: DEC-0044, LC-19. Where a host starts this stdio server. project: for the sessions of a project that binds it, from that project's MCP configuration. on-demand (the default when absent): for the run that binds it, stopped when that run ends. session: in every session; spelled so that FAC-SEM-056 refuses it by name.

requiredFeatures.description: The MCP tools, resources and prompts the capability needs, by exact name, as tool:NAME, resource:NAME or prompt:NAME (docs/specification/profiles.md#mcp-capability-profile).

probes.description: The semantic probes the host runs before admission (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

a2aProfile.description: The a2a profile; its version member is protocolVersion (docs/specification/profiles.md#a2a-peer-profile).

protocolVersion.description: The a2a profile's version member; only this profile carries protocolVersion (docs/specification/profiles.md#a2a-peer-profile).

agentCardUrl.description: The https URL of the peer's Agent Card (docs/specification/profiles.md#a2a-peer-profile).

skillIds.description: The Agent Card skill ids that serve this capability (docs/specification/profiles.md#a2a-peer-profile).

binding.description: The A2A binding: REST, JSON-RPC or gRPC (docs/specification/profiles.md#a2a-peer-profile).

streaming.description: Whether the peer streams task updates.

pushNotifications.description: Whether the peer sends push notifications.

probes.description: The semantic probes the host runs before admission (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).

localRunnerProfile.description: The local-runner profile; its version member is profileVersion (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

profileVersion.description: The local-runner profile's version member; only this profile carries profileVersion (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

runnerKind.description: The runner kind, such as claude-code or codex, or a namespaced extension (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

executableRef.description: The URI of the executable the host starts (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

args.description: The argument template, an array of strings with typed placeholders, never a shell string (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

inputMode.description: How the runner receives its input: stdin-json, file-json or argument-file (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

resultUriTemplate.description: Where the runner writes its result envelope (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

cancellation.description: How a run is cancelled: signal, command or unsupported (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often the runner reports it is alive, 1 to 300 seconds (docs/specification/profiles.md#local-runner-profile).

probes.description: The semantic probes the host runs before admission (docs/specification/registry.md#semantic-probes).
